subject.title: fix(secrets): collect persona-level TTS provider SecretRefs

question: After the code findings and consumer-path proof are resolved, should persona TTS SecretRefs land under the current eager fail-closed startup contract, or wait for the separate optional-TTS missing-key policy decision?
rationale: This PR fixes valid SecretRefs, but expanding eager collection also makes missing persona credentials participate in startup failure; repository policy treats that operator-impact boundary as a maintainer-owned compatibility and security decision.

options.title: Land under the current contract
options.body: Merge after repair and proof, accepting that unresolved active persona TTS SecretRefs fail startup consistently with other active SecretRefs.

options.title: Sequence after optional-TTS policy
options.body: Hold this PR until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101265 or another approved design defines missing TTS credential behavior.

recommendation.title: Land under the current contract
recommendation.body: Merge after repair and proof, accepting that unresolved active persona TTS SecretRefs fail startup consistently with other active SecretRefs.

likelyOwner.reason: The team owns the changed secrets runtime and credential-surface files and is best placed to accept or sequence the fail-closed boundary.
